Key Takeaways
1. Five Russian drones, including Banderol loitering munitions, crashed in Moldova on the morning of October 3, exceeding the number of aerial vehicles involved in the last Russian violation of Moldovan airspace.
2. Russian forces struck the Northern Bridge in Kyiv City on October 3 as part of Russia's continued efforts to degrade the city's traffic across the Dnipro River and cause wider disruptions to Ukraine's economy and daily civilian life.
3. Ukrainian forces continued their long-range strike campaign against missile and drone launch sites in Russia. Russia launched 157 drones against Ukraine overnight and Banderol loitering munitions on the morning of October 3.
4. Russian forces recently advanced southeast of Sumy City.

"Russian forces have struck the Southern and Northern bridges in Kyiv City six separate times since the afternoon of October 1"
The Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated it would "continue launching long-range drone and missile strikes against Ukraine".
